name: Oregon
terms: Oregon is stricter than federal law: a wine named for an AVA needs 95% of its grapes from that AVA, and one named for an AVA wholly in Oregon must use only Oregon grapes.

notes: Oregon Pinot Gris is medium bodied, yellow to copper-pink, with aromas of pear, apple and melon.

blurb.text: A US wine state where Pinot Noir and Pinot Gris are the two most planted and most harvested grapes.
